reach-hook.purpose: get sent to other owners: a sharp, relatable pain in 2 seconds
reach-hook.notes: pain-first hook, one open loop, payoff on the last second; no offer

story-proof.purpose: build trust with a real before/after and what changed for the client
story-proof.notes: needs real proof and written client permission; compliance check on claims

authority-explainer.purpose: show how you think: a mistake, a method, a teardown of a site
authority-explainer.notes: carousel or vox explainer; one idea per slide

offer-cta.purpose: make the next step obvious for people already warm
offer-cta.notes: at most 1 in 10 posts; no prices; the user posts it

conversation.purpose: start two-way replies: a question, a poll, a hot take
conversation.notes: cheap to make; reply within the first hour
